laws.rule: Hangzhou: smoking is banned in indoor public places, indoor workplaces and on public transport (article 5). Outdoor bans cover children's venues, other schools' teaching areas, women's and children's hospitals, sports and performance areas, and heritage sites open to the public. Hotels, restaurants and entertainment venues were given a time-limited exception with smoking areas (article 6). A person who smokes in a banned place is ordered to stop at once (article 25).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 50 (about A$10.67); CNY 200 (about A$42.66) if the person does not stop. (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 杭州市公共场所控制吸烟条例 (Hangzhou Public Places Tobacco Control Regulation)

laws.rule: Ningbo: smoking in indoor public places, public transport and lifts, putting up notices or scribbling on walls, trees and poles, throwing hazardous objects from a building (article 36) and throwing objects from a moving vehicle (article 37) all carry fines.
laws.penalty_signal: Smoking: CNY 50 (about A$10.67); CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66) in more serious cases; CNY 200 to 500 (about A$42.66 to A$107) in the most serious (article 33). Posting, scribbling or carving: CNY 50 to 300 (about A$10.67 to A$64.00) if not removed in time (article 34). Throwing from a building: CNY 50 to 500 (about A$10.67 to A$107) (article 36). Throwing from a vehicle: CNY 200 (about A$42.66) for the driver, CNY 50 (about A$10.67) for a passenger (article 37). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 宁波市文明行为促进条例 (Ningbo Civilised Behaviour Promotion Regulation)

laws.rule: In scenic areas, swimming, playing or climbing in areas that are officially closed to it is banned (article 33). The management body orders it to stop.
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 50 to 500 (about A$10.67 to A$107) (article 54). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 浙江省风景名胜区条例 (Zhejiang Province Scenic Areas Regulation)

laws.rule: Riders and passengers of electric bicycles must wear a safety helmet, and children aged six or under need a child seat (article 17). Riding without a plate or licence on the road leads to a fine and the bike being held (article 23). Modified bikes that go faster than the national limit are also penalised (article 26).
laws.penalty_signal: Helmet or child seat: warning or CNY 20 to 50 (about A$4.27 to A$10.67) (article 25). No licence plate: CNY 50 (about A$10.67) and the bike is held. Speed limiter removed: CNY 300 to 500 (about A$64.00 to A$107). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 浙江省电动自行车管理条例 (Zhejiang Province Electric Bicycle Regulation)

laws.rule: Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area: banned acts include taking over or filling the water, quarrying, breaking or carving bamboo and trees, damaging lawns, picking flowers or bamboo shoots, hunting or netting, scribbling or pasting on features, damaging public facilities, lighting fires, picnic cooking or setting off fireworks in the hills, smoking in fire-ban zones or periods, burning incense or candles beyond set limits, dumping rubbish, keeping poultry or livestock, and pitching tents or placing tables outside set areas (article 27).
laws.penalty_signal: Most of the acts in article 27 (breaking or carving trees, scribbling, damaging facilities, picnic or fire use, smoking, rubbish): CNY 20 to 1,000 (about A$4.27 to A$213) and compensation for loss. Hunting or netting: CNY 500 to 2,000 (about A$107 to A$427) with gear seized. Blocking water: CNY 500 to 5,000 (about A$107 to A$1,067); taking over water surface: CNY 200 (about A$42.66) per square metre. (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 杭州西湖风景名胜区管理条例 (Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area Administration Regulation)

laws.rule: Zhejiang: unmanned aircraft may not take off or fly in no-fly times and zones, and are banned above important national and public-safety sites (articles 11 and 12). Using a drone to throw items, carry banned goods, disturb work or teaching, harm people or property, or spy on or photograph a person's private life is banned (article 13). Changing a drone or its electronic fence without permission is banned.
laws.penalty_signal: Flying in a no-fly time or zone, or altering the electronic fence: for an individual CNY 1,000 to 5,000 (about A$213 to A$1,067) (article 18). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
